selection_disclosure: Post-audit mechanism-illustration case, not a statistically representative case. It was chosen after the corrected full matrix showed that the 50-customer median-feature case structurally suppresses route-pool recombination, while the 100-customer tier is the first tier with frequent genuine recombination. The full 81-instance table remains the generality evidence.
algorithm: Archive-route-reuse MV-HGS-SP, the only algorithm repair that passed its preregistered development gate.
endpoint_gate: Across ten seeds, MV-HGS-SP must have zero losses to every single view, at least eight strict wins over HGS-F and HGS-E, at least seven strict wins over HGS-M, and lower mean cost than every single view.
trajectory_gate: Only if the endpoint gate passes, run a separately instrumented observation replay. Final endpoints must match exactly; plot all original observations with ordinary straight segments, no smoothing, interpolation, broken axis, normalization, or hand-selected seed.
claim_boundary: The case may illustrate mechanism behavior and convergence shape only. It cannot replace the full China81 statistics or be called representative.
